item.title: The Breakup
item.description:
This is part of exercises I took in the writing workshop at Esalen in July 2026. This breakup was in 2014. This was on the \(3^{rd}\) day.

I am putting a book in the envelope. “The Little Prince”, has a signature of my now ex-girlfriend and date when it was gifted to me. My hands are steady but there is a volcano bubbling inside. I am angry at her, at my family, at the whole situation.
